title: Institutionally grounded sensitivity extension
chronology: Fixed after the existing Section 8.8 outcomes were known, before computing this extension. Reuses its holdout dates; not a new independent holdout or registered protocol.
institutional_mapping: Fixed-profile option: published illustrative contractual availability is 3000 kVA at 00:00–06:00 and 1000 kVA otherwise. Retain clock windows and normalized 3:1 shape, and translate it to an aggregate resource envelope. Absolute electrical units, site eligibility and utility approval are not inferred from GPU data.
dates: All 14 previously selected holdout dates, 2017-10-09 to 2017-10-22
capacity_formula: C_raw(t) = (R/4)*(8489/2)*(G if t mod 24 < 6 else 1); test 8*load(t)<=R*8489*(G if t mod 24 < 6 else 1). Training median peak=4244.5 GPU-seconds.
modes: 0 reject, 1 reference, 2 six-hour delay, 3 twelve-hour delay; same 36-hour profiles and exposures as Section 8.8.
tie_rule: First mode vector in lexicographic order, as in Section 8.8.
outcomes: blind allocation and admission differences and complete-horizon infeasibility
identical reference-profile menu changes when competitors lose twelve-hour options
identical reference-profile menu and admission changes across adjacent overnight ratios
exchange-property violations of the feasible admitted-set family
scope: Descriptive sensitivity, no causal field effects, no empirical private preferences, no actual grid capacities, no population probabilities or confidence intervals.
zero_cases: Retain all zero-optimum cases in level/count denominators; exclude only undefined relative losses.

bundle_diagnostic.mode: Same broad-versus-disjoint-narrow bundle construction as Theorem 3. One normalized exposure unit each; per-period capacity 1/r and common capacity 2. Net values can be nonpositive; rejection allowed. Gross-value-first rule scans largest value first with deterministic broad-first ties.

audit: Exact integer allocation/payment/IR/accounting checks for all records; independently enumerated sampled profiles and a baseline comparison; separate bundle arithmetic in Wolfram.
